databases.name: corpus
databases.retention: The corpus plugin owns retention for its perennial archive.

databases.description: Immutable perennial harvest from agent transcripts and harvested files.
questions: What did the harvested agent corpus record?
Which sessions, exchanges, reasoning blocks, tool uses, or files were harvested?

tables.name: sessions
tables.description: Harvested conversation sessions with source, project, timing, title, and source metadata.

tables.name: memories
tables.description: Harvested files with a first-class provenance that distinguishes their route into the archive.
questions: Which files or durable records were harvested?

tables.name: exchanges
tables.description: Immutable human and agent exchanges with timestamps and source-recorded model usage provenance.
questions: What was said in harvested conversations?

tables.name: tool_uses
tables.description: Tool calls harvested from exchanges, including failures and initiative classification.
questions: Which tools were used and which calls failed?

tables.name: thinking_blocks
tables.description: Reasoning blocks harvested from sessions and exchanges.
questions: What reasoning was recorded in the harvested corpus?

tables.name: memories_fts
tables.description: Accent-insensitive full-text index over harvested file content.

tables.name: exchanges_fts
tables.description: Accent-insensitive full-text index over harvested human and agent exchange text.

tables.name: thinking_fts
tables.description: Accent-insensitive full-text index over harvested reasoning.

tables.name: sessions_fts
tables.description: Accent-insensitive full-text index over harvested session titles and projects.

tables.name: legacy_flow_patterns
tables.description: Quarantined derived flow patterns retained from the retired core database.

tables.name: plugin_schema
tables.description: The corpus database schema and index versions together with its migration state.

tables.name: plugin_migrations
tables.description: Lifecycle and verification outcome of every named custody migration this database hosts.

tables.name: migration_batches
tables.description: Fully committed, checksummed source batches imported into corpus custody.

tables.name: custody_memberships
tables.description: Source identities represented by each physical row in corpus custody.

verbs.name: ingest
verbs.description: Import one account export or the configured live agent sources into the corpus.
